description: This file is a Perl script named 'chainlint.pl' that scans shell scripts for test definitions and checks those tests for problems such as broken '&&' chains or unclosed heredocs. It contains classes for lexical analysis, parsing shell scripts, and specifically parsing test definitions, as well as a main execution section handling command-line arguments, processing files, and reporting results.

classes.name: Lexer
classes.description: Perl class responsible for tokenizing POSIX shell scripts, handling special tokens, quoting, HEREDOCs, and recursion within shell expressions. It generates lexical tokens for the parser.

classes.name: ShellParser
classes.description: Recursive descent parser modeling POSIX shell grammar, responsible for parsing sequences of shell commands, compound commands, and control structures.

classes.name: TestParser
classes.description: Subclass of ShellParser with semantic knowledge of test construction. Checks for common problems in tests such as missing '&&', missing '|| return 1', or unclosed heredocs.

classes.name: ScriptParser
classes.description: Subclass of ShellParser that identifies individual test definitions within scripts, passing test bodies to TestParser for analysis.

methods.name: new (Lexer)
methods.description: Constructor for Lexer class, initializes with parser reference and input buffer.

methods.name: scan_token
methods.description: Lexical analysis method that scans and returns the next token from the input shell script.

methods.name: new (ShellParser)
methods.description: Constructor for ShellParser, initializing parser state and lexer.

methods.name: next_token
methods.description: Returns the next token using the lexer, with buffering support.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Main parsing function in ShellParser; recursively parses shell commands until stop tokens.

methods.name: new (TestParser)
methods.description: Constructor for TestParser, initializing problems list.

methods.name: parse_cmd
methods.description: Overrides parse_cmd in ShellParser to identify test commands and invoke problem checking and reporting.

methods.name: check_test
methods.description: Analyzes a test body to detect problems such as missing '&&' or unclosed heredocs.

methods.name: format_problem
methods.description: Converts internal problem codes into human-readable descriptions.

methods.name: unwrap
methods.description: Extracts raw content of tokens, handling quoted and composite strings.
